brief:
Israeli forces demolished five homes in Biddu, a village in the occupied West Bank, according to Al Jazeera English. The demolitions displaced more than 100 Palestinians from their residences.

The demolitions are part of Israel's ongoing practice of destroying Palestinian homes in the West Bank, a policy Palestinians and international rights groups say violates international law and amounts to collective punishment.
dek: Israeli forces demolished five homes in Biddu, occupied West Bank, displacing more than 100 people.
title: Israeli forces demolish five homes in Biddu, displace over 100 Palestinians
